text.tspan: Covers US 7.0.1. The PDF job flow exists for Admins.
"(proposed)" = the step is not in the code today.
includeImages is false by default today.
AT 3 needs photos, so the request must set it.
Today /api/pdf/route.ts does not read the owner. It checks only user_metadata.role === 'admin'.

svg.text: Select Export PDF on own SIR (proposed for stewards)
Today: only role admin from user_metadata
and photos as SIR page (AT 1, AT 3)
US 7.0.1: Let Stewards Export Their Own Reports
